attributes.description: Verdict-or-refusal decision surface. Proves pairing/sample/cadence/coverage before emitting an A/B verdict with effect size + replicate spread. Absence shown as absence. All queries bind ?_tstart/?_tend, exclude warmup.

params.markdown:
## Evidence contract — read before trusting any verdict
**Question:** Does Proton-GE **ge10-34** regress frametime vs **ge10-7** on *Cyberpunk 2077*?

**Rules enforced:** `warmup` runs excluded · **3 replicates per arm** · verdict requires **paired coverage** across frame/cpu/gpu/power · effect size = Δ of per-arm means · uncertainty = **spread of replicate means** (not tick variance) · parity judged **within spread**.

**Absence is shown as absence.** A stream that is unstamped or whose window does not overlap the A/B run yields a **REFUSAL**, never a fabricated zero. All panels are bound to the dashboard time range (`?_tstart`/`?_tend`).

query.esql: FROM metrics-rigsignal.frame-default | WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend AND rigsignal.game.name == "Cyberpunk 2077" AND NOT rigsignal.session.label LIKE "*warmup*" | EVAL arm = CASE(rigsignal.session.label LIKE "*ge10-34*", "ge10-34", "ge10-7") | STATS arm_mean = AVG(rigsignal.fps.frametime_ms) BY arm | STATS delta_ms = MAX(arm_mean) - MIN(arm_mean)

attributes.title: VERDICT — Frametime effect size Δ (ge10-34 − ge10-7)

query.esql: FROM metrics-rigsignal.frame-default | WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend AND rigsignal.game.name == "Cyberpunk 2077" AND NOT rigsignal.session.label LIKE "*warmup*" | EVAL arm = CASE(rigsignal.session.label LIKE "*ge10-34*", "ge10-34", "ge10-7") | STATS rep_mean = AVG(rigsignal.fps.frametime_ms) BY arm, rigsignal.session.label | STATS replicates = COUNT(*), mean_ms = AVG(rep_mean), min_rep_ms = MIN(rep_mean), max_rep_ms = MAX(rep_mean), spread_ms = MAX(rep_mean) - MIN(rep_mean), mad_ms = MEDIAN_ABSOLUTE_DEVIATION(rep_mean) BY arm | SORT arm ASC

attributes.title: UNCERTAINTY — per-arm replicate spread (mean of replicate means ± range/MAD)

query.esql: FROM metrics-rigsignal.stream_client-default | WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend | STATS total_docs = COUNT(*), joinable_docs = COUNT(rigsignal.session.id) | EVAL verdict = CASE(joinable_docs > 0, "CORRELATABLE", "REFUSED — 0 session-stamped docs")

attributes.title: REFUSAL — stream_client network verdict WITHHELD (session-unstamped, no window overlap)

query.esql: FROM metrics-rigsignal.frame-default | WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend AND rigsignal.game.name == "Cyberpunk 2077" AND NOT rigsignal.session.label LIKE "*warmup*" | EVAL arm = CASE(rigsignal.session.label LIKE "*ge10-34*", "ge10-34", "ge10-7") | STATS mean_frametime_ms = AVG(rigsignal.fps.frametime_ms) BY replicate = rigsignal.session.label, arm | SORT replicate ASC

attributes.title: A/B per-replicate mean frametime (zero-based, colored by arm) — pairing 3×3 visible

query.esql: FROM metrics-rigsignal.frame-default | WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend AND rigsignal.game.name == "Cyberpunk 2077" AND NOT rigsignal.session.label LIKE "*warmup*" | EVAL arm = CASE(rigsignal.session.label LIKE "*ge10-34*", "ge10-34", "ge10-7") | STATS n = COUNT(*), avg_ms = AVG(rigsignal.fps.frametime_ms), p95_ms = PERCENTILE(rigsignal.fps.frametime_ms, 95), p99_ms = PERCENTILE(rigsignal.fps.frametime_ms, 99), stutters = SUM(rigsignal.fps.stutter_count) BY arm, replicate = rigsignal.session.label | SORT replicate ASC

attributes.title: A/B per-replicate detail — n / avg / p95 / p99 frametime / Σ stutter (warmup excluded)

query.esql: FROM metrics-rigsignal.frame-default, metrics-rigsignal.cpu-default, metrics-rigsignal.gpu-default, metrics-rigsignal.power-default METADATA _index | WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend AND rigsignal.game.name == "Cyberpunk 2077" AND NOT rigsignal.session.label LIKE "*warmup*" | EVAL stream = CASE(_index LIKE "*frame*", "frame", _index LIKE "*cpu*", "cpu", _index LIKE "*gpu*", "gpu", "power") | STATS docs = COUNT(*) BY replicate = rigsignal.session.label, stream | SORT replicate ASC, stream ASC

attributes.title: Evidence-sufficiency matrix — docs per session per stream (proves pairing & cadence)

query.esql: FROM metrics-rigsignal.ebpf-default | WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend | EVAL session_kind = CASE(rigsignal.session.id IS NULL, "NULL (unstamped)", rigsignal.session.id == "no-session", "no-session (sentinel)", "stamped game capture") | STATS docs = COUNT(*), distinct_ids = COUNT_DISTINCT(rigsignal.session.id) BY session_kind | SORT docs DESC

attributes.title: Sentinel / null accounting — eBPF no-session vs stamped sessions (absence surfaced)

query.esql: FROM metrics-rigsignal.cpu-default | WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend AND rigsignal.game.name == "Cyberpunk 2077" AND NOT rigsignal.session.label LIKE "*warmup*" | EVAL arm = CASE(rigsignal.session.label LIKE "*ge10-34*", "ge10-34", "ge10-7") | STATS cpu_util = AVG(rigsignal.cpu.total_utilisation_pct) BY ts = BUCKET(@timestamp, 30 seconds), arm | SORT ts ASC

attributes.title: CPU utilisation over time by arm (worst-moment locator)

query.esql: FROM metrics-rigsignal.gpu-default | WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend AND rigsignal.game.name == "Cyberpunk 2077" AND NOT rigsignal.session.label LIKE "*warmup*" | EVAL arm = CASE(rigsignal.session.label LIKE "*ge10-34*", "ge10-34", "ge10-7") | STATS gpu_util = AVG(rigsignal.gpu.utilisation_pct), gpu_temp = AVG(rigsignal.gpu.temperature_c) BY ts = BUCKET(@timestamp, 30 seconds), arm | SORT ts ASC

attributes.title: GPU utilisation & temperature over time by arm

query.esql: FROM metrics-rigsignal.power-default | WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend AND rigsignal.game.name == "Cyberpunk 2077" AND NOT rigsignal.session.label LIKE "*warmup*" | EVAL arm = CASE(rigsignal.session.label LIKE "*ge10-34*", "ge10-34", "ge10-7") | STATS tdp_w = AVG(rigsignal.power.tdp_current_w) BY ts = BUCKET(@timestamp, 30 seconds), arm | SORT ts ASC

attributes.title: Power (TDP current W) over time by arm — gauge avg, never summed across ticks
